charts.startupLegendStar: ★ = among the fastest in the kit
charts.startupDesc: Shorter bar = faster move. Startup in frames (60 fps, dissidia.wiki data), with priority after the value. Moves marked ★ are the fastest in the kit — usually your best punish and pressure tools.
charts.chainTitle: Chain diagram: every “One” Bravery attack can chain into any equipped “Two” followup
charts.chainDesc: Every “(One)” Bravery attack (left) can chain into any equipped “(Two)” followup (right) — the followup is picked when equipping, not during the combo. Details for each move in the accordions above.
charts.mobilityAria: Mobility profile: where this character sits in the cast for each speed stat
charts.mobilityCaption: Mobility profile (normal mode) — position within the cast
charts.mobilityTitle: For each speed: gold dot = this character, small dots = all 31 characters, violet line = average. Further left = faster.
charts.mobilityDesc: Gold dot: this character · small dots: the rest of the cast · violet line: average. Wiki values, lower = faster; the rank on the right reads directly (1st = fastest).
charts.skillchainDesc: A Skillchain triggers by chaining a move from the left column (starter) into a move from the right column (finisher) — when several pills are listed, any of them works.

calendar.lede: The competitive scene's calendar: announced upcoming tournaments and every documented past one. A watcher polls start.gg twice a day; Discord DISSIDIA announcements are relayed by hand.
calendar.noUpcoming: No upcoming tournament announced right now. Announcements land in the announcements channel of the Discord DISSIDIA — tournaments created on start.gg show up here automatically, the rest are relayed by hand.
calendar.detectedDesc: The watcher spotted these messages in the announcements channel; they are listed as-is pending a manual check (date, ruleset, sign-up).
calendar.howBody: Twice a day, an automatic watcher queries start.gg's official API: every Duodecim tournament created there shows up here on its own, with its date and link. Announcements from the announcements channel of the Discord DISSIDIA (Challonge brackets in particular) are relayed to the calendar by hand. Past tournaments come from the Tournaments page, where each edition is documented with its ruleset and results.
calendar.noCheckYet: The automatic watch has not run yet — the calendar reflects the last manual pass (July 2026).
calendar.limitStartgg: Only start.gg is covered automatically (official API). The Discord DISSIDIA announcements channel is an ordinary text channel that cannot be followed from another server: its announcements — Challonge brackets in particular, which have no public search API — are relayed by hand and can arrive late.
calendar.limitElsewhere: A tournament announced only elsewhere (Twitter/X, whose read API is paid, or another server) can slip past the calendar.
calendar.metaDescription: Dissidia 012 [duodecim] tournament calendar: upcoming editions and past tournaments, updated automatically from start.gg and the Discord DISSIDIA.
